assertions.name: Desktop final-subpath HTTP 200, meaningful English homepage and six resources
Combined topic, format, full-text search and empty-state filters
Bookmark persistence across reload and saved-list filtering
Substantive lesson, incorrect/correct knowledge check, durable completion, clipboard link, deep link and Escape
Toolkit downloads a meaningful original checklist with source attribution
Keyboard-operated commute scenario: 4 km × 5 days × (0.20 − 0.04) = 3.2 kg CO₂e
Keyboard map exploration, actual personal ICS download and honest-data FAQ
Desktop after interactions: no horizontal overflow
Keyboard onboarding selects a learning path and restores meaningful focus
Preview server does not expose private metadata
Public license and attribution link returns complete MIT notices
Mobile after interactions: no horizontal overflow
Mobile touch navigation, topic filtering, learning/quiz, modal close, bookmark, map and calculator
No browser console/page/request/resource errors on desktop or mobile

visualReview.method: 通过 view 工具实际打开最终 desktop.png、mobile.png、desktop-library.png、mobile-action.png 和新生成 preview.png。
visualReview.desktop: 暖白底色、深绿色文字、衬线标题与原创拱形风景画形成清晰层级；留白、间距、对齐与色彩一致，未见裁切或重叠。
visualReview.mobile: 390px 下单列内容与导航收起正确，主标题和插图比例协调，计算器控件和结果完整可读，无横向溢出。
visualReview.lowerSections: 资源三列布局、插图和保存状态清晰；移动端情境计算器的标签、选择框与结果均在容器内。额外截屏包含实际操作后的短暂保存提示，不是静态页面内容。
refinements: 地图使用 group 语义，避免 img 角色遮蔽交互按钮。
公开许可链接采用 LICENSE.txt，实际 HTTP 200 核验。
